clauses.clause: Corpse piles ≤ ~1 m, no stretched limbs; player never drawn under a corpse.
clauses.note: FAIL height clause: transformed retained frozen corpse vertices (airborne thrown/blast bodies excluded) top2.140822m low protected full route and1.919446m high protected full route, against approximate1m pile target. Independent mortal low war-only route reaches1.703713m. Measurement subtracts local ground(body centreY-.7), not just world Y. Actual full-route heap close/wide frames personally reviewed. Alpha natural death pose can itself be about1.48m; no source change or waiver. All-pose limb stretching and universal courier occlusion are not promoted PASS. Repro: run current renderer complete L4 and inspect frozen vertex maximum at cellar entry.
